from pathlib import Path
import collections
program = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v != background for v in row) > w / 2]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(h)) > h / 2]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(row_lines, row_lines[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(col_lines, col_lines[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            row.append(corners[0] if all(x == corners[0] for x in corners) else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
